title: ThreeTenBP complete hours across midnight
summary: Compare the complete-hours result on two dates against signed elapsed minutes. Qualify the adapter separately by constructing both endpoints independently on the JVM.

change.description: Account for incomplete days before counting whole time units.

notes: Both revisions agree with direct JVM calls through the hours adapter. The pinned parent returns 1 hour from 23:30 to 00:15 the next day and -1 in reverse. The fix returns zero in both directions. Same-day and sign-reversal checks pass on both.

Both the correct hours adapter and its wrong-unit control ran on both pinned artifacts. The hours adapter agreed with all 36,864 independently constructed calls in each revision. The MINUTES control differed on 36,672 pairs per revision. All five strict native obligations reached BigInteger.valueOf(long) in Duration.<clinit> and remain open. Their collected attempt bundles are discoverable from workflow_handoff.py.
verdictLabel: 6,912 clock discrepancies before the fix on 36,864 ordered JVM calls
